description: Grappleless Maridia from the west tube door through Full Halfie, Draygon, and Space Jump

rules.name: Maridia Tube direct to Main Street
Botwoon fight and loot from the direct Maridia route
rules.notes: Input tape searched from botwoon_hallway_direct_r204. Leaves with 186 energy and three Supers for Full Halfie and the eye door.

rules.name: Draygon charge-beam fight and Space Jump Room exit
rules.notes: Searched from the Full Halfie route's 59-energy entry. Finishes with 27 energy and retains all missiles, Supers, and Power Bombs for the following rooms.

rules.name: Oasis direct to West Sand Hall
rules.notes: Bypass Pants Room and the Spring Ball detour. The breakaway floor leads straight to the west exit.

rules.name: Business Center direct to Frog Savestation
rules.notes: Use the existing elevator and floor descent controller from the no-crocomire entry.

rules.name: Purple Shaft via the Gamet farm
rules.notes: From 108 energy, collect Gamet drops through a full energy refill before Lava Dive, then return to the shaft and exit to Magdollite Tunnel.

rules.name: Golden Torizo charge fight
rules.notes: Collect the missile pack and search charged Plasma shots from the recovered Acid Statue entry.

rules.name: Golden Torizo Super Missile expansion
rules.notes: Climb from the actual Screw Attack return position and take the Super Missile pack.

rules.name: Red Kihunter Shaft with normal bombs
rules.notes: Use regular bombs through the descent and morph tunnel. Spend one Power Bomb on the yellow hatch and carry the spare into Wasteland.

rules.name: Wasteland descent without Spring Ball or Grapple
rules.notes: Spends the carried Power Bomb on the upper Wasteland morph blocks and replaces the Grapple SELECT wrap with Item Cancel.

rules.name: Metal Pirates Room Item Cancel entry
rules.notes: Replaces the opening Grapple SELECT wrap with Item Cancel (Y) on frame 0.

rules.name: Ridley charge-beam fight with Power Bomb drop sweep
rules.notes: Charge+Ice+Wave+Plasma kill with a short pause RNG shift before death explosion to drop Power Bombs and collect 4/5 PB for Wasteland and Red Kihunter Shaft return.

rules.name: Wasteland return without Spring Ball
rules.notes: Unmorphs and jumps to the upper ceiling green door ledge (1397, 91) without Spring Ball.

rules.name: Red Kihunter Shaft return with Item Cancel
rules.notes: Replaces Grapple SELECT wraps with Item Cancel (Y) while spending 2 Power Bombs on the return climb.

rules.name: Lower Norfair Spring Ball Maze +5 Missile pickup
rules.notes: Collects the +5 Missile pack (raising max missiles from 30 to 35 for the Tourian budget) and matches door exit speed into Three Musketeers' Room.

rules.name: Bubble Mountain floor exit without Spring Ball
rules.notes: Shoots the bottom floor door open downward into Purple Shaft without Spring Ball.

rules.name: Red Tower Space Jump climb with midair ceiling break
rules.notes: Direct Space Jump ascent with midair upward shot through the top shot blocks (836f vs 2,004f baseline).

rules.name: Hellway direct Space Jump crossing
rules.notes: Direct Space Jump + Screw Attack crossing to Caterpillar Room (478f vs 1,751f baseline).

rules.name: Brinstar Reserve + Early Supers + 3x Missile detour without Spring Ball
rules.notes: Collects Brinstar Reserve Tank (+100R), Early Supers (+5S), both Brinstar Reserve Room missile packs, and the Early Supers floor missile pack (raising max stock from 35M to 50M/15S/100R) using air-morph and morph bombs without Spring Ball.

rules.name: Statues Room Item Cancel
rules.notes: Replaces the post-statue Grapple SELECT wrap with Item Cancel (Y).

rules.name: Seaweed Room 1-Super red door
rules.notes: Opens the Seaweed Room red door with 1 Super instead of 5 Missiles (+2 missile-eq into Mother Brain Room: 50M/12S = 86 eq).

rules.name: Tourian Eye Door Room Item Cancel
rules.notes: Replaces the opening Grapple SELECT wrap with Item Cancel (Y).

rules.name: Mother Brain 1+2 Clean solve for no_crocomire (0xDD58)
rules.notes: Clean Zebetites + Glass + MB1 + MB2 + Rainbow kneel solve from the no_crocomire 50M/12S entry using morph bombs (no Spring Ball); feeds directly into live escape controllers r332-339.
